❓ Frequently Asked Questions

What is Windrose?

Windrose is a naval exploration and survival game where you sail, fight, and explore a procedural ocean world.

Is Windrose free to play?

Windrose is available on PC. Check the official store page for current pricing and sales.

Can I play Windrose solo?

Yes! Windrose is fully playable solo. Most content is designed for 1–4 players.

What is the best starter ship?

The Sloop is the best ship for beginners — fast, easy to manage solo, and capable in combat.

How do I boost FPS in Windrose?

Disable Motion Blur, V-Sync, and Ambient Occlusion. Reduce Shadow Quality and Water Detail for the biggest FPS gains.
